title: 下一手在这里
description: 成人站在垫区外以手指轻示相邻两块大手点的短距离。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult stands beside the landing boundary and compares two neighboring large jug holds on the low wall, raising an open hand to indicate the short space between them. The body stays on the floor, shoulders relaxed, and the gesture is observational rather than a reaching climb. Place the relevant holds prominently in the middle of the frame, with large foot supports below and a quiet friend listening from a safe distance. Use layered cardboard diorama illustration with folded architectural planes, readable joints, small material shadows, and beige, aqua, and orange accents. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
